title: LIGHTHOUSE R1 — Conditional Spectral Information Gate

core_upgrade.new_axis: S_spectral as a measured spectral profile with provenance and uncertainty
core_upgrade.monochromatic_special_case: If a source is physically demonstrated to be monochromatic, SPD may reduce to lambda plus measurement uncertainty.

S_MEASURED.definition: Direct sensor measurement from a calibrated spectrometer/multispectral/hyperspectral acquisition chain.

S_DERIVED_FROM_RGB.definition: Spectrum reconstructed from RGB or another already-counted parent representation.
S_DERIVED_FROM_RGB.information_rule: If S_hat=f(V_RGB) deterministically, then I(Y;S_hat|V_RGB,A,C)=0 by construction. A stochastic transform with independent randomness also cannot be credited as independent evidence about the observed object without an external measurement source.

magic_key_split.MK_memory_ID: Distinguishes a specific cultural/sensory target inside a frozen candidate universe.
magic_key_split.MK_memory_FUTURE: Retains only cue distinctions that change correctness-relevant future memory operations or admissible retrieval behavior.
magic_key_split.future_equivalence: Two spectral observations may be physically different yet merge under MK_memory_FUTURE if they lead to the same certified memory neighborhood and identical allowed future operations.
magic_key_split.firewall: Physical difference alone does not force a future-state distinction.

primary_endpoints.interpretation: Utility is experimental accounting, not a theorem metric.

anti_leakage_protocol.split_rule: Holdouts must be grouped by acquisition session and device where applicable; random sample splits alone are insufficient.
anti_leakage_protocol.device_rule: A sensor fingerprint or session drift may not be credited as target identity.
anti_leakage_protocol.derived_channel_rule: Any feature whose derived_from lineage points to an already-counted parent channel is excluded from independent-evidence credit.
anti_leakage_protocol.estimator_rule: Mutual-information estimator, preprocessing, binning/band selection and thresholds must be frozen before holdout inspection.
anti_leakage_protocol.permutation_null: Observed conditional information gain must be compared against shuffled-spectrum permutation null; positive point estimate alone is not certified information gain.
anti_leakage_protocol.bootstrap: Report holdout uncertainty/bootstrap interval where statistically meaningful.

welfare_firewall.rule: No increase in cue resolution, collision reduction, confidence, spectral specificity or memory retrieval accuracy modifies W_t automatically.
welfare_firewall.pipeline: SENSORY_EVIDENCE -> CUE_RESOLUTION -> MEMORY_CANDIDATES -> HUMAN_SELECTION/CONSENT/EXIT -> MEMORY_ASSIST -> RETURN_PRESENT

signals: Associative/context-gated retrieval motivates testing separation gain from an extra context dimension.
Hyperspectral band-selection literature motivates measuring information gain and redundancy rather than assuming every wavelength is useful.
RGB-to-spectrum and metamer literature supports treating reconstructed spectra as inverse-problem outputs, not independent physical observations.
Multimodal retrieval literature motivates ablation and modality-complementarity controls.
Photonic computing literature supports wavelength as a computational/measurement degree of freedom without intrinsic semantic meaning.

next_action: Run only on a frozen corpus with real measured spectral evidence or clearly labeled calibrated synthetic controls. Do not treat screenshots or RGB-derived spectra as independent evidence. Preserve raw provenance and charge sensing/calibration/retrieval/verification costs.

scientific_boundary.status_note: This file freezes the test architecture before empirical results.
